blueprint.name: ke_bien
blueprint.doc: The pieces of the sea walls of Vũng Tàu: the parapet of the walk of Hạ Long and its panels of red brown granite, the sloped sea wall of concrete of Hạ Long, the low wall of granite blocks of the beach of Bãi Trước, the sloped sea wall of granite blocks under it, and the steps down to the sand. Each piece goes along a line from its port start (x = -length/2) to its port end (x = length/2); +y is the side of the sea, and z = 0 is the walk. Vũng Tàu, data/world/blueprints/ke_bien.json.
sources: The parapet of Hạ Long: the photo of Kwozyn, 2019-02-21 (Commons, File:Vũng_Tàu_sunset.jpg, CC BY-SA 4.0), and the photo of VnExpress of 2021-07-16 (vnexpress.net/vung-tau-vang-lang-trong-covid-19-4325863.html).
The sloped sea wall of Hạ Long: the photos of Venanzio_KH of 2021-05-10 (Flickr 51180048443 and 51179824566) and of trungydang of 2014-04-05 (Commons, CC BY 3.0).

The low wall of the beach: the photos of VnExpress of 2020-04-02 (vnexpress.net/pho-bien-yen-vang-4079788.html), Marcus Nguyen of 2018 (Flickr 50064549148 and 50075678016) and Lam Tr Th of 2014-03-09 (Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0).

The stone sea wall and the steps of Bãi Trước: the photos of Ted McGrath of 2019-01-24 (Flickr 47924741823, CC BY-NC-SA 2.0), Nguyen tan dat Dat of 2019-06-22 (Flickr 48108232968), Hữu Nghĩa Nguyễn Huỳnh of 2019-02-02 (Flickr 50955595227), and a walk of Huy Đi Lang Thang of 2020-06-22 (YouTube haFi_72WxO4).

params.name: kind
params.doc: The piece. lan_can_ha_long: a piece of the parapet of the walk of Hạ Long. tru_lan_can_ha_long: a piece of that parapet with a body of red brown granite under its grey top slab. ke_ha_long: a piece of the sloped sea wall of concrete of Hạ Long, with rocks at its foot. tuong_bai_tam: one span of the low wall of granite blocks of the beach of Bãi Trước. ke_da_bai_truoc: a piece of the sloped sea wall of granite blocks under that low wall. bac_xuong_cat: a piece of the steps of granite from the walk down to the sand.

params.name: length
params.doc: The length of the piece along x, from the port start to the port end.

params.name: height
params.doc: The top over the walk (a parapet, a pillar, a low wall), or the drop from the walk down to the foot (a sloped sea wall).

params.name: width
params.doc: The thickness along y of a parapet, a pillar, or a low wall and its posts.

params.name: cap_width
params.doc: The width along y of the top slab of a parapet, or of the rail of a low wall.

params.name: cap
params.doc: The thickness of the top slab of a parapet, or of the rail of a low wall.

params.name: run
params.doc: A sloped sea wall: the length along y from its top edge to its foot.

params.name: rock
params.doc: ke_ha_long: the size of a rock at the foot of the slope.

params.name: post
params.doc: tuong_bai_tam: the length along x of a post (a half post at each end of the span).

params.name: base
params.doc: tuong_bai_tam: the height of the wall under the openings.

params.name: course
params.doc: The height of a course of granite blocks.

params.name: block
params.doc: The length of a granite block (the joints of a course).

params.name: blocks
params.doc: The joints of one course along the piece (length / block, and one).

params.name: courses
params.doc: The courses with a joint line under them.

params.name: steps
params.doc: bac_xuong_cat: the count of steps (the joints of the blocks are drawn on 8 steps).

params.name: step_rise
params.doc: bac_xuong_cat: the height of one step.

params.name: tread
params.doc: bac_xuong_cat: the depth along y of one step.
